maddeler.e:
تستصحبوا (form X)
# تَسْتَصْحِبُوا (tastaṣḥibū) /tas.tasˤ.ħi.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَصْحَبَ (istaṣḥaba)
# تُسْتَصْحَبُوا (tustaṣḥabū) /tus.tasˤ.ħa.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَصْحَبَ (istaṣḥaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
